forum.title: HAL_I2C_EnableListen_IT() is not enabling Address matched interruption
forum.best_answer_content: I had an hardware issue on my SCL pin sorry about this useless post
forum.content_text:
Hello

I am trying to implement I²C slave on a STM32U385RGTxQ in non-blocking mode, on I2C2.

To match I²C standard I tried to use the Address macthed interruption but the interruption is never trigged. I used the function HAL\_I2C\_EnableListen\_IT(&hi2c2) to enabled it;

My issue is, I don't reach neither the I2C2\_EV\_IRQHandler(void), the I2C2\_ER\_IRQHandler(void) or the HAL\_I2C\_AddrCallback() when sending the slave address.

Please found attached my project. And bellow some pictures of my I2C2 init, an oscilloscope capture and my I2C2 register when I am in debugger :

![Tiboww_0-1776428073420.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/7adc803c-7c7b-3fad-8342-7fa5de968e2c.png "Tiboww_0-1776428073420.png") ![Tiboww_1-1776428083198.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ae98379c-94d0-38e8-1445-f27b037c2c49.png "Tiboww_1-1776428083198.png")

![Tiboww_2-1776428150417.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/d803576a-2b36-f802-a148-2ed27867faaf.png "Tiboww_2-1776428150417.png")

![Tiboww_3-1776428199946.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/f42dc0bc-7aba-2349-eaac-253fc2e8fc8b.png "Tiboww_3-1776428199946.png")

Best Regards

Thibaud HABRAND
